entry_points.summary: Amend plans/FIX; preserve completed tasks; reclassify changed tasks.
Read-only plan audit; route when no plan, changes, or doc drift.
Plan style audit pre-implementation; dispatches plan-style-reviewer; PLAN_STYLE_AUDIT.md; hard STYLE.md gate; no --no-style escape.
Three-ideator pre-plan brainstorm; mandatory anti-bias check; slug-confirm resolver (skip/prefill/ask/conflict/halt) after hard collision check; halt emits brainstorm_halt.

Unknown-root-cause debug flow; Phase 2.5 conditional bisect fast-path; hypothesis rounds; posterior table; MR-review on fix; post-mortem; Phase 10 memory-review (shipped branch only); slug-confirm resolver (halt→debug_halt) in Setup; active-plan registration in Setup after debug_run_start; FINALIZE_STATUS rule covers all exit paths.
Read-only component audit; parallel auditor subagents per dimension; bundled consult; REPORT.md + TASKS.md for /z-implement-all.
Authoritative pipeline for plan-style auditing; STYLE.md hard gate; dismissal-extraction loop; plan-style-reviewer agent fanout; PLAN_STYLE_AUDIT.md with T-PS-NNN IDs.
Fast-path fix for known-diagnosis bugs; Phase 0 wrong-tool gate; light-fix consult; inline implementation; Codex review; optional post-mortem; slug-confirm resolver in Setup.
Meta-skill for patching misleading SKILL.md/command/agent files; diagnosis note; surgical edit; reviewer safety gate.

Overnight chain orchestrator: runs comma/arrow-separated sub-command pipeline unattended with Z_HARNESS_NO_ASK=halt carve-out, heartbeat lock, overnight-state.json, MORNING_REPORT.md, resume support, preflight slug-collision check, and push-notify on halt or completion.

Plan-less small-task runner; active-plan registration in Setup after do_run_start; config.py export-env at Setup step 6; should-notify guards on all PushNotifications; doc-fetcher grounding (skipped when Z_HARNESS_DOCS_ALWAYS_APPLY=never); reviewer gate.

Full task queue orchestration; --tasks fast path; tree gates; batching; caps; Phase 0.0 registration inside Setup after slug-discovery + tree-validation bind $BASE; scope-extractor seeds scope; graduated overlap policy (OVL_RC 0/10/20/other); heartbeat at each task-dispatch boundary; FINALIZE_STATUS rule; Phase 9 memory-review; deduped push-notify via .notify-dedup-session.

Single-task implementation; model from **Complexity:** stamp; execution order: Phase 0.2 slug-discovery → Phase 0.0 register → Phase 0.1 lock-check; heartbeat at task-dispatch boundary; reviewer gate; no auto-retry.
Post-run retro; proposes <=5 harness edits; concept_hints from touched paths; memory suggestion.
Bootstrap two-tier docs, INDEX files, TAGS seed, MEMORIES-FLAT.
Refresh stale docs; dedup_tags:true; preserve memories; pre-audit compaction state; tags; flat-memory regen.

Terrain-mapping; cost gate (Phase 0); slug+artifact collision handling (Phase 0.5, after cost gate); --slug flag; doc-fetcher-first; up to 3 Explores tracked dispatched vs succeeded; bundled critique; no-recommendation invariant; slug-confirm resolver (halt→map_halt) in Phase 0.5. Produces MAP.md.
Small-fix planner; FIX.md only; inline implementation; reviewer gate; active-plan registration in Setup after light_run_start; FINALIZE_STATUS rule; slug-confirm resolver (halt→light_halt) in Setup.

Split 2-6 clusters; cluster_id vs cluster_slug; strict early-exit telemetry; overlap reconciliation; active-plan registration in Setup after plan_split_run_start; FINALIZE_STATUS rule covers all hard-refuse exits.

Full planner; active-plan registration in Setup immediately after run_start; config.py export-env at Setup step 4a; should-notify guards on PushNotifications; docs-freshness gate; consult; SPEC/PLAN/TASKS; parallel complexity-classifier; scope-extractor seed after TASKS.md finalized; heartbeat at Phase 8 boundary.

Meta-orchestrator: dispatch decision (Phase 0, user-driven) → cost gate (Phase 0.5, always before Phase 1) → inline /z-map + /z-brainstorm sub-commands → adversarial synthesis panel (3 perspectives + research-judge Opus) → 10-section RESEARCH.md. Cost 3-6M tokens.

Final diff review; pre-Phase-0 resume check (handles halted:no_ask_blocked state via review_resume_from_halt); test-suite gate; Phase 3.7 two-stage compaction (check-no-ask first → halt writes partial state file; then resolve-question for skip/prefill/ask); REVIEW-TASKS; Phase 7 memory-review with memory_review_terminal; clears .notify-dedup-session at Phase 0 and Phase 7 start.

Read-only shell metrics; Phase 0b prints resolved base + repo-id + active plan count from registry; Phase 4b reads review_agent_call + memory_review_terminal events with old-shape phase_end back-compat; Phase 4c reads askuser_resolved events (preference resolutions by result/source/question_id + conflict rate).

Sole memory authoring path; --from-candidate-json; --concept-hints; atomic writes; MEMORIES-FLAT regen; --kind routing-preference mode writes to workflow[-.].json bypassing interactive collection; Phase 3a routing-flavored text redirect gate.
Optional semantic test-case planner; cross-LLM consult; TESTS.md; cross-links TEST-NNN into TASKS.md.
Update z-harness plugin; symlink=git-pull, tarball=atomic-swap; emits harness_updated event.
Bulk codebase quality uplift: decompose into components, cross-cutting pass, parallel auditor subagents, sequential z-implement-all.

Read-only registry diagnostic; Phase 0 prints base+repo-id header; Phase 1 renders live active-plan table (slug, command, phase, branch, current_task, age, status; stale if last_heartbeat >30min); Phase 2 optional overlap check via --run-id or Z_HARNESS_RUN_ID (OVL_RC 0/10/20). No writes, no LLM calls, no subagent dispatch.

invariants: Route bails write route-decision.md, emit plan_route_decision, ask user, then stop.
planning-router is advisory; deterministic route thresholds and loop prevention win.
Plan artifact paths resolve via $Z_HARNESS_PLAN_DIR after slug discovery.
Consults use consultant-primary/secondary; review uses reviewer.
doc-fetcher is the cheap docs-grounding path before broader exploration.
z-suggest-memory is the only supported memories[] mutation path.
doc-updater must preserve existing memories verbatim.
Telemetry uses log-event.sh/log-phase.sh so z-stats can compute wall time.
Phase 9 (z-implement-all), Phase 7 (z-review-all), and Phase 10 (z-debug shipped-branch) are soft; all failure paths silently skip.
run-memory-review.sh gates whether a review-agent dispatch is warranted before any candidate prompt.

memory_review_terminal is emitted by run-memory-review.sh for all skip states; by the skill for ran_empty and needs_user states. review_agent_failed and review_agent_malformed are orthogonal failure-class events and never emit memory_review_terminal.
Broken-context skip push-notify (tags_missing, no_plan_dir, missing_args) uses .notify-dedup-session keyed by slug:reason to suppress duplicate notifications within a session.
z-debug memory-review (Phase 10) runs only on the status:shipped branch; abandoned debug sessions emit no memory-review telemetry.
z-debug Phase 10 clears .notify-dedup-session unconditionally before the shipped/abandoned branch split.
z-plan-split emits plan_split_run_end on every exit path (success, partial, refused, abandoned).
cluster_id (C1..CN) is for telemetry; cluster_slug is the on-disk directory name — never swap.
z-maintain-docs always passes dedup_tags:true to doc-updater subagents.
z-review-all Phase 3.7 compaction breakpoint always runs between Phase 3.5 and Phase 4.
z-review-all Phase 3.7 runs check-no-ask before resolve-question; halt result writes partial .review_state.json (halted:true, halt_reason:no_ask_blocked) and exits without AskUserQuestion.
z-review-all Pre-Phase 0 handles halted state files: emits review_resume_from_halt, deletes the file, proceeds to full Phase 0 re-run (not fast-forward).
z-debug fix-gate requires posterior==very_high AND zero unexplained evidence rows before any fix.
z-uplift MANIFEST.md is the single resume authority; state transitions are atomic via tmp-then-rename.
z-uplift never writes production code directly; it orchestrates audits via auditor subagents and delegates implementation to z-implement-all.
z-uplift gates on STYLE.md presence before decomposition; it never auto-invokes z-style-init or z-maintain-docs.
perf is excluded from z-uplift default dimensions to bound cost; must be added explicitly via --dimensions.
z-implement-next is single-shot; no auto-retry on review failure.
z-test cross-LLM consult (mode test-cases) is non-skippable.
z-test writes TESTS.md only; no SPEC.md or PLAN.md edits; only appends **Tests:** to TASKS.md.
z-update aborts symlink mode on dirty plugin tree; aborts tarball mode if RELEASE_URL still points at example.com.
z-fix Phase 0 wrong-tool gate is non-skippable even if $ARGUMENTS is non-empty; a symptom description is not a hypothesis.
z-fix inline implementation self-check mirrors the implementer subagent checklist; main thread applies edits directly for 1-5 file changes.
z-fix mid-implementation scope growth triggers an unconditional halt and escalation.md write; no continue or subagent spawn.
z-audit is read-only; it never edits the target; fixes happen later via /z-implement-all consuming the emitted TASKS.md.
z-audit Phase 4 cross-LLM consult (both Gemini and Codex in parallel) is non-skippable.
z-audit Phase 6 Codex reviewer safety gate on the produced TASKS.md is non-skippable.
z-audit-plan-style STYLE.md gate is non-skippable; no --no-style flag exists; missing STYLE.md causes immediate exit recommending /z-style-init.
z-audit-plan-style is read-only; PLAN_STYLE_AUDIT.md findings are shaped for /z-amend promotion; correctness findings belong to /z-audit-plan.
z-audit-plan-style archives any existing PLAN_STYLE_AUDIT.md before overwriting to power the dismissal-extraction loop.
z-skill-fix Codex reviewer safety gate on every patched skill file is non-skippable.
z-skill-fix never auto-commits; commit decision is always delegated to the user.
z-debug Phase 2.5 bisect fast-path never blocks the pipeline; refused/failed/bisect_unusable all fall through to Phase 3a.
z-debug bisect offending SHA does not pre-fill the winning hypothesis; fix-gate still requires full posterior + evidence-coverage convergence.
Before any git reset --hard, commit --amend, or interactive-rebase squash on a tracked branch, run git branch -r --contains <sha>; STOP if upstream ref appears.

config.py export-env is called at startup in z-do (Setup step 6) and z-plan (Setup step 4a) to populate all Z_HARNESS_* env vars; skills that do not yet call export-env must use Z_HARNESS_NOTIFY_LEVEL with a default fallback.

All PushNotification calls gated by config.py should-notify --event <type> returning yes, except hard-pause notifications (compaction breakpoints, halt-on-skip-flagged) which fire regardless of notify level.
Notification policy knobs (notify.level, docs.always_apply) are documented in docs/human/config.md; skills reference that file rather than inline documentation.

Slug-confirm resolver (config.py resolve-question workflow.slug_confirm) now has four results: skip, prefill, ask, halt. halt fires when Z_HARNESS_NO_ASK=halt is active; each skill emits its own halt event (brainstorm_halt, debug_halt, light_halt, map_halt) and exits without AskUserQuestion.
The hard unconditional slug-dir collision check runs before the slug-confirm resolver and is never bypassed by resolver outcome.
config.py emits askuser_resolved for every resolved question; resolver errors fall through to ask mode (never silently skip).
z-stats Phase 4c reads askuser_resolved events; it is read-only and never writes.
z-suggest-memory --kind routing-preference requires --question-id, --value, --strength, and --scope; mutually exclusive with --edit, --delete, and --from-candidate-json.
z-suggest-memory --kind routing-preference writes to docs/llm/workflow.json (global) or docs/llm/workflow-<project-slug>.json (project scope); creates stub + INDEX entry if file absent.
z-research Phase 0 (dispatch decision, user-driven) runs before Phase 0.5 (cost gate); cost gate always runs before Phase 1 sub-command dispatch.
z-research requires at least one sub-command to succeed before launching the synthesis panel; all 3 panel perspectives must succeed before calling research-judge.
Registry Phase 0.0 runs after slug/base discovery binds $Z_HARNESS_SLUG and $BASE; it must not create a record before any structural-validation halt that would leave an uncleanable zombie.

FINALIZE_STATUS rule: any run-ending halt AFTER REG_RC==0 (a record exists) sets FINALIZE_STATUS=aborted and calls deregister --status aborted; on register failure (REG_RC!=0) do NOT deregister (no record was written).
Compaction-pause exits (condition 3 in z-implement-all) are pauses not aborts; do NOT deregister; the next invocation re-registers idempotently.

Overlap scan exit codes: 0=no overlap (silent proceed); 10=advisory overlap (proceed/wait/abort gate, unattended proceeds); 20=blocking (only under Z_HARNESS_STRICT_OVERLAP=1 with explicit*explicit path match) — unconditional halt.
Heartbeat calls use || true and must never block task dispatch on a registry error (best-effort, non-fatal); the CLI self-logs registry_error on internal failure.
z-where does not emit start/end telemetry events for itself; it is read-only against the registry and never writes.
z-stats Phase 0b always prints the resolved base + repo-id + active-plan count header unconditionally (not gated behind Z_HARNESS_EXPLAIN_RESOLUTION).
z-implement-next execution order is Phase 0.2 (slug-discovery, binds $BASE) → Phase 0.0 (register) → Phase 0.1 (lock-check); the document order differs from the execution order.
gotchas: z-audit-plan cannot run without SPEC/PLAN/TASKS; no-plan routes to z-plan.
z-audit-plan-style has a hard STYLE.md gate with no --no-style override; this differs from z-uplift which accepts --no-style for degraded mode.
z-audit-plan-style emits PLAN_STYLE_AUDIT.md (separate from PLAN_AUDIT_REPORT.md produced by z-audit-plan); findings have T-PS-NNN IDs.
z-do may not route directly to z-plan-split.
z-do skips doc-fetcher entirely when Z_HARNESS_DOCS_ALWAYS_APPLY=never (config knob).
Route chains cap at two entries and block ping-pong to the prior command.
z-plan-split cluster_id is telemetry-only; cluster_slug is the path segment.
z-implement-all --tasks derives BASE from task-file parent and skips tree gates.

z-implement-next Phase 0.1 lock check halts the entire run if a follow-up consumer is running; it fires after Phase 0.0 registration so a record exists and must be deregistered (FINALIZE_STATUS=aborted) before exit.
z-implement-next has no auto-retry; flip stamp to **Complexity:** high and re-invoke, or use z-implement-all.
z-maintain-docs --audit may pause before consultant audit and fast-forward via state.
Adding a tag alias records TAGS.txt only; memory tags collapse on a later run.
MEMORIES-FLAT.md regen is mandatory after doc writes or memory mutations.
--from-candidate-json bypasses z-suggest-memory Phases 3a-3f; candidate must have type and text or returns bad_input.
Phase 4b in z-stats reads review_agent_call events AND memory_review_terminal events with old-shape phase_end back-compat; it is read-only and never writes.
Phase 4c in z-stats reads askuser_resolved events; if none found, prints a 'none found' note and skips the conflict-rate line; read-only.

review_agent_malformed and review_agent_failed are orthogonal failure-class events — they do NOT emit memory_review_terminal. In z-implement-all Phase 9, review_agent_malformed triggers a push-notify hint; review_agent_failed also triggers a push-notify. Neither halts the run.
z-debug Phase 10 memory-review only runs on the shipped branch. Abandoned debug sessions (status:abandoned) do not call run-memory-review.sh.

Broken-context skip push-notify uses .notify-dedup-session (keyed slug:reason); z-review-all clears this file at Phase 0 start AND again at Phase 7 start; z-debug clears it at the top of Phase 10 (before shipped/abandoned split); z-implement-all clears it before first task dispatch.
z-debug auto-bail no longer triggers on >5 files; only cross-module/arch/public-surface change triggers escalation.
z-debug hard cycle cap is 5 (halt when cycle 6 would be needed); soft warning fires at cycle 3. Cycle cap overridable via AskUserQuestion only.
z-debug Phase 2.5 bisect is conditional: only fires when bug is a regression with known-good baseline and scriptable repro.
z-debug bisect-isolator is dispatched as a Haiku subagent, not a consultant; orchestrator-only likelihood-bucket rule still applies to its output.

z-review-all pre-Phase-0 deletes stale .review_state.json if HEAD changed or artifacts missing. A halted:no_ask_blocked state file is NOT treated as stale: it emits review_resume_from_halt, deletes the file, and triggers a full Phase 0 re-run (not fast-forward).

z-review-all Phase 3.7 is a two-stage gate: check-no-ask fires first (halt→write partial state file with halted:true + exit 0); then if proceed, resolve-question runs for skip/prefill/ask. The halt state file is not a fast-forward token — Pre-Phase 0 always does a full re-run after halt.
z-plan Phase 8 complexity-classifier strips existing **Complexity:** line before dispatch to force re-classification.
z-research --slug= token must be stripped from $ARGUMENTS before computing input_hash; z-map does the same.
z-research Phase 0 is dispatch decision (user-driven, reads MAP_STATE + BRAINSTORM_STATE); Phase 0.5 is the cost gate. The cost gate always follows the dispatch decision.
z-research tracks EXPLORES_DISPATCHED vs EXPLORES_SUCCEEDED separately (in sub-command z-map); frontmatter uses succeeded count.
z-plan Explore cap is 3 per run; prefer direct Read/Grep/Glob over a 4th Explore call.
z-suggest-memory --concept-hints is comma-separated; first hint is the pre-selected recommended option.
z-test cross-task tests (task: null) are not linked into TASKS.md; deferred to /z-review-all or manual follow-up.
z-update tarball mode halts if Z_HARNESS_RELEASE_URL still points at example.com.
z-uplift slug collision detection presents one AskUserQuestion per colliding slug before COMPONENTS.md is written.
z-uplift --refresh-component archives both REPORT.md and TASKS.md atomically before resetting the MANIFEST row; both files must exist or command exits with error.
z-uplift cross-cutting context (C-NNN lines) is filtered per component slug using exact-match on component: field; global or mismatched slugs are silently excluded.
z-fix auto-bail threshold is >5 candidate files OR >2 non-obvious decisions OR cross-module/cross-crate impact — check at both Phase 1 end and throughout.
z-fix hard inline implementation limit is 7 files; halt unconditionally at that threshold regardless of FIX.md scope.
z-fix REVIEW_CYCLES counter gates the optional post-mortem default: default=NO when <=1, default=YES when >1.
z-fix does NOT auto-trigger MR-review; run /z-mr-review separately if needed.
z-audit auto-bail thresholds are >30 total findings OR >10 CRITICAL/HIGH findings post-consult; check after Phase 4.
z-audit escalation writes escalation.md and recommends /z-plan; no TASKS.md is generated on bail.
z-audit TASKS.md must include a minimal SPEC.md and PLAN.md for /z-implement-all to resolve context.
z-skill-fix only patches skill/command/agent files; bugs in repo code, missing CLAUDE.md conventions, and policy disputes are out of scope.
z-skill-fix never weakens a gate or pushback rule even if the gate was inconvenient in a specific case.

config.py export-env is only invoked in z-do and z-plan; z-implement-all, z-review-all, and z-debug still reference Z_HARNESS_NOTIFY_LEVEL directly with a default fallback — they have not yet been updated to use export-env.
should-notify --event <type> accepts approval, error, and phase_end event types; hard-pause notifications bypass this check entirely.

Slug-confirm resolver now has a halt result in addition to skip/prefill/ask/conflict. halt means Z_HARNESS_NO_ASK=halt is blocking the question; each skill emits its own halt event without calling AskUserQuestion.
Slug-confirm preference resolver (resolve-question workflow.slug_confirm) runs only after the hard collision check passes; the collision check is never gated by resolver outcome.

On slug-confirm conflict (config says X, memory says Y), the question header surfaces the conflict, and a one-shot follow-up offers to record the user's answer (config / memory:very_strong / memory:strong / no).
z-suggest-memory --kind routing-preference is mutually exclusive with --edit, --delete, and --from-candidate-json; combining any two returns STATUS: bad_input.
z-suggest-memory --kind routing-preference validates question_id via config.py list-question-ids; unknown IDs return bad_input immediately.
z-suggest-memory Phase 3a routing-flavored text detection only fires when candidate text is already available AND no explicit type is set; no-match or no-text cases proceed silently to Phase 3b.
z-suggest-memory yes-config branch in Phase 3a invokes config.py set, which is not yet shipped as of this writing — the call is documented for when it lands.
Registry REG_RC==3 means register FAILED and no record was written; do NOT call deregister on this branch. Any other nonzero REG_RC is treated identically to REG_RC==3 by all skills.

The scope-extractor subagent (Haiku) is best-effort: update-scope returns 0 by design and self-logs registry_error on internal failure; orchestrators call it with || true and do NOT add a || log after it (that would be dead code).
Heartbeat subcommand also returns 0 by design and self-logs registry_error on internal failure; orchestrators call it with || true and must not add a misleading || log after it.

z-implement-all Phase 0.0 must run INSIDE Setup, immediately after Setup step 3 binds $BASE — after all slug-discovery and tree-validation gates. Early-exit gates (tree_depth_exceeded, shared_concerns_missing, etc.) that fire before Phase 0.0 leave no registry record to clean up.
z-where Phase 2 overlap check exit codes: 0=none, 10=advisory (display human-readable output), 20=blocking (prepend [BLOCKING] to header), any other nonzero=registry error (display error message).
z-where staleness threshold for active-plan records is 30 minutes since last_heartbeat; records older than that display as 'stale' regardless of status field.
z-stats Phase 0b active-plan count falls back to '(registry unavailable)' if the registry call fails or returns empty; this is a display-only field and never fails the command.
